frase_clave: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!
reflexion: Live with a wakeful heart, loving in every detail of your day. The Lord comes to meet you today; are you prepared to receive Him with joy?

escenas.descripcion: Jesus sits among his disciples on a grassy hill, speaking with a gentle and serious expression.
A noble Master in a travel cloak hands keys and instructions to his Servants in a warm, sunlit courtyard.
A faithful Porter stands by a wooden door at night, holding a glowing oil lamp and looking out into the darkness.
Jesus looks directly at the viewer with a compassionate gaze, extending his hand in a gesture of invitation.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Mark.
texto_evangelio: At that time, Jesus said to his disciples: “Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is. It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch. Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning; lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping. What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

fragmentos.texto: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Mark.
At that time, Jesus said to his disciples:
“Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning; lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.
What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”
Live with a wakeful heart, loving in every detail of your day. The Lord comes to meet you today; are you prepared to receive Him with joy?

frase_es: Estad atentos, velad, porque no sabéis cuándo llegará el momento.
reflexion_es: Vive con el corazón despierto, amando en cada detalle de tu día. El Señor viene a tu encuentro hoy, ¿estás preparado para recibirle con alegría?
